query.queryString:
SilverRapidDeliveryNearestDrivers
| extend OrderTime = ingestion_time()
| join kind=inner (FabrikamDeliveryTrucks) on $left.TruckID==$right.TruckID
| where OrderTime >= ago(5m)
| project tostring(SalesOrderNumber),
OrderTime,PickupAddressLine1,PickupAddressLine2,PickupPostalCode ,Fullname,
TruckEntraID
| sort by OrderTime,SalesOrderNumber
